items.text: Never have I ever fallen asleep on public transport and missed my stop.
Never have I ever waved back at someone who was actually waving at the person behind me.
Never have I ever pretended to know the lyrics and just mumbled through the chorus.
Never have I ever walked straight into a glass door.
Never have I ever laughed so hard a drink came out of my nose.
Never have I ever rewatched a whole series instead of starting a new one.
Never have I ever said “you too” when a waiter told me to enjoy my meal.
Never have I ever burned instant noodles.
Never have I ever gotten lost in my own neighborhood.
Never have I ever hidden behind a shelf to avoid someone I know at the grocery store.
Never have I ever cried at a kids' movie.
Never have I ever talked to a pet and waited for it to answer.
Never have I ever forgotten someone's name seconds after they told me.
Never have I ever sent a voice message by accident.
Never have I ever sung karaoke in front of total strangers.
Never have I ever eaten dessert for dinner as an adult.
Never have I ever pretended to be on a call to avoid talking to someone.
Never have I ever broken a bone.
Never have I ever tripped on a perfectly flat floor and glared at it like it was the floor's fault.
Never have I ever stayed up all night to finish a game or a book.
Never have I ever called a teacher “Mom” or “Dad” in front of the class.
Never have I ever been ghosted.
Never have I ever ghosted someone.
Never have I ever scrolled through an ex's profile late at night.
Never have I ever accidentally liked a very old photo while snooping on someone's profile.
Never have I ever muted the family group chat.
Never have I ever called in sick when I wasn't.
Never have I ever cheated on a test.
Never have I ever regifted a present.
Never have I ever sent a message about someone to that exact person.
Never have I ever lied about my age.
Never have I ever said my phone died to get out of plans.
Never have I ever been friend-zoned.
Never have I ever eaten someone else's labeled food from the office fridge.
Never have I ever fallen asleep on a video call with my camera on.
Never have I ever borrowed money and conveniently forgotten about it.
Never have I ever googled myself.
Never have I ever posted something just so one specific person would see it.
Never have I ever borrowed something from {random} and never given it back.
Never have I ever read someone else's messages over their shoulder.
Never have I ever left a group chat and then asked to be added back.
Never have I ever drunk-texted an ex.
Never have I ever woken up with no idea how I got home.
Never have I ever gone on a date with someone from a dating app.
Never have I ever had a crush on a friend's partner.
Never have I ever gotten back together with an ex.
Never have I ever kept a relationship secret from my parents.
Never have I ever said “just one more drink” and meant five.
Never have I ever ghosted someone after a first date.
Never have I ever been jealous of my partner's best friend.
Never have I ever looked up my ex's new partner online.
Never have I ever been talking to two people at the same time.
Never have I ever confessed my feelings while drunk and pretended I forgot the next day.
Never have I ever had a crush on someone at this table.
Never have I ever shown up to work or class still hungover.
Never have I ever been dumped over text.
Never have I ever kissed someone on the first date.
Never have I ever made out in a movie theater.
Never have I ever had a secret situationship.
Never have I ever posted a thirst trap for one specific person.
Never have I ever been caught kissing someone by a parent.
Never have I ever kissed a friend and pretended it never happened.
